title: GO derived Control State publication target V1
description: The stable target the derived Control State is published to, what it must record, and what it may never become. It carries no signature, no Task and no executor parameter: the derived state answers questions, it does not issue instructions.

layout.description: The whole target. A reader needs the first entry and nothing else.

CURRENT.json.const: pointer; the only entry point a reader follows

runs/<generated_at>_<content_digest12>/.const: immutable snapshot; never rewritten after publication

LAST_FAILURE.json.const: present only while the most recent attempt failed

status_reported_by_reader.description: The state of the PUBLICATION, derived by the reader from the pointer's age and from LAST_FAILURE.json. Never a re-derivation of control state.

x-meaning.CURRENT: a validated snapshot is published and inside the reader's freshness window
x-meaning.STALE: a validated snapshot exists but the pointer is older than the freshness window
x-meaning.FAILED: the most recent publication attempt failed after the last success
x-meaning.UNKNOWN: no publication has ever been made, or no failure record explains the absence

manifest.description: Provenance. Every published snapshot can be traced back to the exact inputs that produced it.

projector_revision.description: Commit of the projector that produced the documents. Required: an unattributed publication is refused.

source.description: At least one source head must be pinned; a publication with no pinned input is refused.

documents.description: One sha256 entry per projection document, recomputed and compared on every read.

deterministic_rebuild.const: run id is <generated_at>_<content_digest12>, and content_digest covers the four projection documents only, so identical inputs must collide

idempotent_republish.const: re-publishing identical content leaves the snapshot untouched; only published_at advances

run_id_collision.const: the same run id with different content is a failure, never an overwrite

two_phase_commit.const: the snapshot is written and round-trip verified first; the pointer advances only afterwards, atomically

failure_never_advances.const: a failed attempt leaves CURRENT.json byte-identical and records LAST_FAILURE.json

no_hand_editing.const: every read recomputes the document digests and compares them with the manifest, so an edited snapshot is detected

portability.const: a projection or manifest containing a workstation, user or temp path is refused

note.const: Publication is a one-way copy of what the projector derived. It carries no signature, no Task, no nonce and no executor parameter; a test asserts those keys are refused in every file the publisher authors.

properties.x-go-gap: This contract defines the target and the publisher. It does not install a scheduled publication: CC V1 adds no systemd timer or workflow that publishes to the target branch. Until an operator wires it, CURRENT.json does not exist, the reader reports UNKNOWN, and the committed PROJECTION_20260914 snapshot remains a manual record rather than a published state.
